learning_objective: 🎯 We will read about a famous and fun traditional Indian street game, learn about sportsmanship, and see why playing outside with friends is the best!

main_concepts.concept_title: 🏏 The Fun Game of Gilli Danda
main_concepts.simple_explanation: Gilli Danda is an old outdoor game played with two wooden sticks. You use the big stick (Danda) to hit the small stick (Gilli) as far as you can!
The story takes us into an exciting match between friends. Everyone is running, jumping, and trying their best to win the game.
Winning or losing is not the most important part. The real magic is having fun, laughing together, and being a good sport.

fun_activity.title: 🎨 Indoor Target Practice
fun_activity.instructions: Roll up a pair of clean socks into a ball and use a rolled-up newspaper as a bat. Try to hit the sock ball softly into a laundry basket!

quick_recap: ⭐ Gilli Danda is a fun, traditional game played with a big and small wooden stick.
⭐ Hitting the Gilli far away requires good focus and timing.
⭐ Playing fair and enjoying time with friends is the real victory.
